catalogue.title: Gadget catalogue
catalogue.subtitle: Everything you need to rule the world, sorted by blast radius.
catalogue.helpText: The catalogue lists every gadget your organisation owns or can order. Prices include assembly but not the lair renovations that some doomsday devices quietly require.
emptyCatalogueBody: Try a wider blast radius, or ask the workshop to build something new.
gadget.freezeRay.name: Freeze Ray Mk II
gadget.freezeRay.description: Turns any hero into a very cold, very annoyed statue.
gadget.shrinkRay.name: Pocket Shrink Ray
gadget.shrinkRay.description: Makes problems smaller. Also buildings. Mostly buildings.
gadget.deathRay.name: Classic Death Ray
gadget.deathRay.description: The original. Warm-up time: one dramatic monologue.
gadget.jetpack.name: Volcano Commuter Jetpack
gadget.jetpack.description: Gets you from the lair to the crater rim before the coffee cools.
gadget.robotShark.name: Robo-Shark with Optional Laser
gadget.robotShark.description: Swims, bites, and fires a laser. The laser is sold separately, as tradition demands.
gadget.mindControlHat.name: Obedience Fedora
gadget.mindControlHat.description: Fits any head. Opinions not included.
gadget.invisibilityCloak.name: Mostly Invisible Cloak
gadget.invisibilityCloak.description: Invisible from the front. We are working on the back.
gadget.explodingPen.name: Signature Exploding Pen
gadget.explodingPen.description: Click three times to sign. Click four times to leave.
gadget.grapplingHook.name: Dramatic Exit Grappling Hook
gadget.grapplingHook.description: Rated for one villain and one cape. Laughter adds no weight.
gadget.doomsdayStarter.name: Doomsday Device (Starter Edition)
gadget.doomsdayStarter.description: Ends the world in a small, manageable region. Upgrade to Overlord for continents.
gadget.moonMagnet.name: Moon Magnet
gadget.moonMagnet.description: Pulls the moon a little closer for better lighting during heists.
borrowedToast: {{device}} checked out. Please return it with all its parts.
gadgetLoadError: Couldn't load the gadget. It may have been shrunk.
gadgetDeleteConfirm: Delete {{device}} from the catalogue? Minions who borrowed it will keep it, the workshop will lose its blueprints, and nobody will remember how the self-destruct was supposed to be switched off.
upgradeForDoomsday: Upgrade to Overlord to order doomsday devices.
henchmanTraining: Training required before first use. Ask a senior henchman.
lowCharge: Low charge: villainy may be underwhelming
deathRayCooldown: The death ray needs {{minutes}} minutes to cool down between monologues.
jetpackFuelNotice: Jetpacks run on a blend of rocket fuel and pure ambition. Refuel only at approved lair stations; the volcano vents are hot enough, but the warranty does not agree.
freezeRayDefrostWarning: Freeze rays build up frost inside the barrel. Defrost every 30 freezings, or the next hero you aim at will only feel mildly refreshed. Use the defrost cycle, not a hair dryer borrowed from a henchman.
gadgetJammed: {{device}} has jammed. Have you tried hitting it?
invisibilityCloakCare: Wash invisibility cloaks by hand in cold water. Do not tumble dry. If you lose one, search the laundry room carefully, because it will not be easy to spot.
warranty.title: Warranty
warranty.voidHeroes: Warranty void if used against heroes
warrantyTerms: This warranty covers manufacturing defects for twelve months. It does not cover damage from lava, sharks, monologues longer than ten minutes, or any situation in which a hero turns the gadget against its owner.
warrantyClaimSent: Claim sent. The workshop will blame the operator within 3 working days.
returnPolicy: Unused gadgets can be returned within 30 days in their original packaging. Gadgets that have been used, even once and even on a very minor hero, count as used.
recallNotice: {{device}} has been recalled. Stop using it and step slowly away.
recallReason: Some Robo-Sharks from the spring batch developed a fondness for their targets and refused to bite. If yours has started bringing heroes small fish, return it to the workshop for a free personality reset.
recallAffected_one: {{count}} unit in your arsenal is affected
recallAffected_other: {{count}} units in your arsenal are affected
safety.title: Safety warnings
safetyNotAToy: Not a toy. Unless you are very, very evil.
safetyGoggles: Wear protective goggles. The dramatic kind is fine.
safetyShrinkSelf: Never point a shrink ray at yourself before saving your work.
safetyJetpackIndoors: Jetpacks are not for indoor use, even in large lairs.
mindControlHatNotice: Mind-control hats only work on minions who are not already wearing a hat. Ask your team to remove all headwear before the briefing, including the tinfoil ones they think you have not noticed.
shrinkRayUndo: Shrinking can be undone within {{minutes}} minutes. After that the target stays small, and you will have to explain to the board why the new headquarters fits in a shoebox.
outOfRangeError: Target out of range. Move the lair or the target closer.
workshop.title: Workshop
workshop.leadTimeHelp: Lead times depend on how many doomsday devices are in the queue. Overlord customers skip ahead of everyone else, which the other customers find very in character.
orderPlaced: Order placed. The workshop has started cackling.
cancelOrderConfirm: Cancel the order for {{device}}? The workshop keeps the deposit and the grudge.
orderForm.specialRequestsHint: Laser colour, self-destruct timer, how ominous the humming should be.
orderForm.overBudget: That is {{amount}} over budget. Consider a smaller doomsday.
ordersEmptyBody: The inventors are idle, which is when they start building things nobody asked for.
lairDeliveryNote: Gadgets heavier than 200 kg are delivered by tunnel. Make sure the secret entrance is unlocked and the lava moat is switched off, or the courier will leave the crate on the beach.
prototypeDisclaimer: Prototypes have not passed safety review. They may hum, glow, or develop opinions. Test them on unimportant islands only, and keep at least one minion between you and the business end.
missingUnits_other: {{count}} units unaccounted for. Check the henchmen's pockets.
inventoryAuditHelp: The audit counts every gadget in every lair and compares it with the books. It takes about an hour, during which minions are asked not to borrow, hide, or test anything.
compare.title: Compare gadgets
compareLimit: You can compare up to {{count}} gadgets at once.
compareEmptyHint: Pick two gadgets to see which one is more evil.
compare.helpText: Comparison uses the latest test results from the workshop. Numbers marked with a skull come from field use against heroes and are, frankly, more honest than the lab data.
sampleReview: Froze the hero, froze the coffee, froze me. Four skulls.
reviewPosted: Review posted. Your overlord may read it.
reviewGuidelines: Be honest, be specific, and do not review a gadget you have only seen used on you. Reviews that reveal a hero's secret identity will be removed, because the legal team is tired.
testFireConfirm: Fire {{device}} at the test range? Make sure no minions are standing on the target.
selfDestructArmed: Self-destruct armed. You have {{minutes}} minutes to look cool and walk away.
tooltip.heroSafe: Cannot harm heroes. We don't know why anyone buys these.
